description:
Area

Bramford Road is a well-established residential location on the western side of Ipswich, offering excellent access to the town and a range of everyday amenities. The surrounding area provides a good mix of local shops, schools, parks and leisure facilities, making it a convenient choice for families, first-time buyers and those looking to be close to the town.

Ipswich town centre is within easy reach, providing an extensive selection of shops, restaurants, cafés and entertainment, while Ipswich railway station offers regular services towards London, Norwich and other major destinations. The property also benefits from good road connections, with convenient access to the A14 and wider Suffolk road network.

The IP1 area offers a popular combination of affordability, convenience and accessibility, with Bramford Road providing a direct route into and out of Ipswich.

The Property

Front Garden - Brick wall to front, laid to stone.

Lounge - 3.5m x 3.3m Entrance door, radiator, double-glazed window to front, laminated floor.

Kitchen/Diner

Dining Area - 4.2m x 3.5m Double-glazed door to rear, island with breakfast bar, storage cupboard, stairs to first floor, radiator, range of kitchen units.

Kitchen Area - 2.8m x 2.1m Double-glazed window to side, single drainer sink, extractor hood, fitted hob and oven, integrated fridge/freezer, wall-mounted boiler, space for washing machine and dishwasher, range of modern white kitchen units.

Bathroom - 2.4m x 2.1m. Double glazed window to side, panelled bath with shower and screen, low level w/c, vanity wash basin, tiled floor, heated towel rail.

Landing - Loft access.

Bedroom 1 - 3.5m x 3.2m. Two double glazed windows to front, built-in wardrobes, radiator.

Bedroom 2 - 3.2m x 2.6m Double glazed window to rear, radiator, storage cupboard.

Bedroom 3 - 2.7m x 2.1m Double glazed window to rear, radiator.

Rear Garden - Outside power points, patio area, raised decked area, shed with power, gate to rear, outside tap.

Helpful Information

Tenure - Freehold

Council Tax Band - A

EPC - C

Year Built - 1900

Flood Risk - Very Low

Money Laundering Regulations

Should a purchaser(s) have an offer accepted on a property marketed by Yopa, they will need to undertake an identification check and asked to provide information on the source and proof of funds. This is done to meet our obligation under Anti Money Laundering Regulations (AML) and is a legal requirement.  We use a specialist third party service together with an in-house compliance team to verify your information. The cost of these checks is £82.50 +VAT per purchase, which is paid in advance, when an offer is agreed and prior to a sales memorandum being issued. This charge is non-refundable under any circumstances.
